enjoy the journey, not just the outcome.

questions.passage: A spontaneous action could help us experience life without prior planning. Some of the most interesting experiences we have are often things we do on a whim. In my case, I was driving my family from Baltimore to Charlottesville one day when I saw a sign for Annapolis. I asked my wife and two kids, “Does anyone want to go to Annapolis?”
questions.prompt: Which paraphrase preserves 'Some ... often ... on a whim'?
questions.promptZh: 哪项改述保留 Some...often...on a whim 的范围？
options: Every interesting event is always planned far ahead.
Some especially interesting experiences arise from unplanned impulses.
Only careless decisions can ever produce interest.
All planned experiences are necessarily uninteresting.
optionsZh: 每件有趣事总提前很久安排。
一些特别有趣的经历来自临时兴起。
只有粗心决定才有可能有趣。
所有计划内经历必定无趣。
analyses: A 与on a whim对照且擅加every。
B Some和often不是全部，on a whim为临时念头。
C 自发不等于粗心，更非only条件。
D 未否定计划体验的所有乐趣；后面家庭故事为个例。

vocabulary.context: 可指有趣自发决定，不自动等于危险、粗心或完全无意识。

vocabulary.context: 这里为肯定接受，不是带否定意思拒绝。

questions.translation: 出乎我意料，每个人都说：“为什么不呢！”于是我们完全没计划地去了 Annapolis。我们在城里闲逛，还乘了一次游船，儿子至今仍会说起。

evidence.quote: To my surprise, everyone said, “Why not!” So we went to Annapolis, totally unplanned. We wandered around town and hopped on a cruise that my son still talks about.
